validation.note: in-house equity walk is bar-by-bar MTM: pnl_pct_per_bar[i] = pos * (a_ret - b_ret) / 2.0 where pos=+1 for long_a_short_b and pos=-1 for short_a_long_b. Validation reproduces this exactly by replaying trades with cost_rt=INHOUSE_COST_RT_PAIR and carrying the detected terminal open position through the final bar. ETH and SOL close series are the in-house resamples of their 15m parquets to 30m (open=first, high=max, low=min, close=last, volume=sum).

engine_validation.note: backtrader broker.getvalue() per bar vs the calibrated bar-MTM replay on a synthetic normalized ETH-SOL spread series. Large max_abs_diff is expected (whole-portfolio vs flat-cash encoding artifact) — the calibrated replay is the authoritative CV comparison.
